ask_body: Send us your question about kittens, and we will add the answers here so they can help others too.
note: We are not vets, and these guides never replace your vet's advice. After 7 years of rescuing and caring for cats with every kind of condition, we share the practical side: the tools, the food, the daily routines and the small tips that make life at home easier for you and your cat.
